access.notes: Crystallographic coordinates for MFI-type ZSM-5 framework; also available via Materials Project or similar databases.

resources.name: Open-source DFT code (CP2K or Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Any DFT package capable of LDA/PWC exchange-correlation functional and pseudopotentials/plane-waves. Quantum ESPRESSO (https://www.quantum-espresso.org/) is an alternative.

resources.name: Pseudopotentials / basis sets for LDA calculations

access.notes: Standard Goedecker-Teter-Hutter pseudopotentials for CP2K, or SSSP efficiency library for Quantum ESPRESSO; included with the DFT codes. Alternatively, all-electron settings with double-numeric basis can be used.
